messages:
Aly (infra): Heads-up: scheduling a rolling maintenance window for the 'ochre' rack in us-west2 on Sun 23:30-01:30 UTC. Scope: NIC microcode + small GPU firmware compatibility patch. No PSU cycles.
Rajat (sre): Copy. Blast radius & plan?
Aly (infra): Expect ~11% capacity dip while nodes drain/rejoin. Plan: node drain -> soft-reboot -> health probe -> uncordon. Cadence ~1 node / 80s, parallelism=3.
Marta (oncall): 11% ok if we seed warm spares. Do we have same-AZ warm nodes with prefix/KV seeded?
Evan (scheduler): Reserving 6 warm GPUs in-region: pool ochre-warm. Seeding job: `ops/seed_cache --pool=ochre-warm --snapshot=snap-2026-03-18 --concurrency=4`. Seed starts 90m pre-window.
June (support): I'll draft the customer blurb for pinned tenants. Proposed: "Planned maintenance in us-west2 may cause transient latency spikes and brief capacity throttling 23:30-01:30 UTC. No data loss expected; contact support for reserved capacity concerns." Will post to #customer-success-drafts.
Rajat (sre): Canary: 2 nodes, 3% traffic for 10m, gates: p95 < baseline+45ms, error-rate <0.7%, MTU-delta < 2%. If any gate fails auto-stop and rollback to compatibility firmware.
Aly (infra): We'll set `route_avoid_recent_boot=true` so nodes with uptime <4m are deprioritized. Also enable temporary region-fallback weights to eu-west for latency-critical routes.
Marta (oncall): Paging rule: if available GPUs in region <6 for >4m page oncall. Also alert on KV miss >9% for 3 consecutive 1m windows.
Rajat (sre): Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ochre-firmware. Rollback steps: pause -> `ops/rollback_firmware --pool=ochre --to=firmware-2026-02` -> rehydrate caches from snap. If p95 regresses >30ms capture: `tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/ochre-canary.pcap`.
net-bot: Reminder: please verify MTU variance and run `ethtool -S` on canary nodes after reboot. Watch for rx_err and tx_retries.
Evan (scheduler): Job encoded: `jobs/ochre/roll-firmware.yaml` (canary_count=2, canary_traffic=0.03, max_parallel=3, backfill_policy=prefer_reserved).
June (support): Cost note: warmbackfill adds ~1.5k USD (GPU hours + IO). Finance approved under infra ops. I'll include cost estimate in customer note for transparency.
Aly (infra): Timeline: 22:00 seed caches; 23:10 smoke tests; 23:30 canary start; 23:45 evaluate; 23:50 roll with parallelism=3; expected finish 01:10; 01:30 cooldown.
Marta (oncall): I'll be standby 23:00-01:45. Add alert: if cross-region failover >7% sustained escalate to infra lead & product.
Rajat (sre): If canary shows persistent TCP retransmits or MTU delta >2% we'll stop and open incident, attach pcap and `ethtool -S` outputs.
Aly (infra): infra-bot will post reminders at 24h, 2h, and 15m. React with :thumbsup: to acknowledge and I'll flip the 2h/15m reminders.
Evan (scheduler): :thumbsup: job queued `ochre-roll-2026-03` (dry-run OK).
June (support): :thumbsup: posting drafts to #customer-success-drafts; will target dedicated tenants directly.
Marta (oncall): :thumbsup: I'll join if canary trips.
Rajat (sre): :thumbsup: prepping dashboards and rollback hooks.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: `ochre-roll-2026-03` at 6501234567, lint OK, dry-run passed.
Aly (infra): Thanks team. I'll publish final blurb after legal/product signoff. Anything else?
Marta (oncall): Nothing more. :coffee:
